title: CONDUIT Open Standard Device Profile
description: A universal, machine-readable description of any connected hardware device: its ports, signal types, protocols, power requirements, physical properties, and typed capability blocks. Version conduit/v1.

schema_version.description: Versioned namespace identifier for this schema. Parsers MUST ignore unknown fields to maintain forward compatibility.

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer name as it appears on the device or official documentation.

model.description: Full model name or number as it appears on the device or official documentation.

model_variant.description: Optional variant, revision, or regional suffix that distinguishes this profile from the base model. Use it only when the SPECIFICATIONS differ (a 55" and a 65" screen, a Rev B with different ports). An order code or part number that identifies the same physical device — a TAA-compliant procurement SKU, a regional pack — is NOT a variant: record it in `order_codes` and keep one profile.

order_codes.description: Manufacturer order codes / part numbers that all refer to THIS device. Several codes commonly identify one physical product (standard vs TAA-compliant procurement, regional packs, bundles), so they belong here rather than forking the profile into near-duplicates.

code.description: The order code or part number as published.

notes.description: What distinguishes this code, when anything does (e.g. 'TAA compliant', 'EU power cord', 'lens not included').

region.description: Region or market this code is sold in, if it is region-specific.

subcategory.description: Optional freeform subcategory for more granular classification within the category.

description.description: Short human-readable description of the device and its primary function.
examples: Single-chip DLP laser projector, WUXGA, 14,000 lumens

rack_units.description: Rack height in U (rack units), if the device is rack-mountable.

power.description: The device's primary power supply. For a device with several independent inputs (an internal AC PSU alongside a 12V DC jack, redundant PSUs), describe each one in `power_inputs`.

power_inputs.description: Independent power inputs, one entry each, when a device has more than one (e.g. an internal AC PSU alongside a 12V DC jack, or redundant PSUs). Name each with `label`. `power` remains the primary/aggregate supply.

ports.description: All physical ports on this device. Each port has a primary signal type and optional signal_modes for multi-mode connectors.

operational_modes.description: Mutually exclusive port configurations this device supports. Use when a set of ports can only be used in one configuration at a time (e.g. '4x HD-SDI OR 2x 3G-SDI'). Each mode names the ports active in that configuration.

capabilities.description: Typed capability blocks providing device-class-specific technical depth beyond what ports alone describe. Each block has a 'type' discriminator. Parsers MUST ignore unknown capability types.

protocols.description: Application-layer protocols supported by this device, beyond what is implied by port signal types.

firmware.description: Firmware or software version this profile was created against.

datasheet_url.description: URL to the official manufacturer datasheet this profile was derived from.

manual_url.description: URL to the official user manual.

image_url.description: URL to a primary product image (photograph or render) of the device.

gdtf_fixture_type.description: Optional reference to a GDTF fixture type UUID.

mvr_class.description: MVR class name for this device, if applicable.

tags.description: Freeform tags for search and filtering.

notes.description: Freeform notes about this device profile — known issues, quirks, or important caveats.

extensions.description: Freeform extension data for domain-specific fields not yet covered by typed capability blocks. Keys should be namespaced (e.g. 'conduit:lighting', 'vendor:acme'). Parsers MUST ignore unknown extension keys.

slots.description: Card slots for modular frame-based devices (intercom matrices, openGear frames, broadcast routers, etc.).

related_devices.description: Other devices that are sold separately but are part of the same system (panels, frames, PSUs, etc.).

sources.description: Structured list of source documents used to create or verify this profile. Prefer this over the flat datasheet_url / manual_url fields.

DeviceCategory.description: Primary category classifying the device's function.

FormFactor.description: Physical form factor of the device.

EnvironmentalSpec.description: Operating and storage environmental envelope for this device.

operating_temp_min_c.description: Minimum operating temperature in degrees Celsius.

operating_temp_max_c.description: Maximum operating temperature in degrees Celsius.

storage_temp_min_c.description: Minimum storage temperature in degrees Celsius.

storage_temp_max_c.description: Maximum storage temperature in degrees Celsius.

humidity_max_percent.description: Maximum relative humidity percentage (non-condensing unless stated).

humidity_condensing.description: Whether the humidity rating includes condensing conditions. Defaults to false (non-condensing).

audible_noise_dba.description: Audible noise level in dB(A) at standard operating conditions.

heat_dissipation_btu_hr.description: Heat dissipation in BTU/hr at maximum load. Important for HVAC and rack thermal planning.

mtbf_hours.description: Mean Time Between Failures in hours.

mtbf_conditions.description: Conditions under which MTBF is specified (e.g. 'Ground Benign at 25°C').

eol_date.description: Manufacturer's stated end-of-life or end-of-production date (ISO 8601).

examples: Three years or 20,000 hours on illumination system

PowerRequirements.description: Power supply and consumption requirements for this device. When a device exposes several independent inputs, use one entry per input and name each with `label`.

label.description: Human-readable name for this supply when a device has more than one (e.g. 'AC mains inlet', '12V DC input', 'PSU 2').

frequency_hz.description: AC frequency in Hz (e.g. 50, 60, or [50, 60] for universal).

typical_wattage.description: Typical operating power consumption in watts.

standby_wattage.description: Power draw in standby mode, in watts.

inrush_current_a.description: Peak inrush current on power-on, in amperes. Important for circuit breaker sizing.

poe_budget_w.description: For PoE switches and injectors: total available PoE power budget in watts across all PSE ports. Separate from device's own consumption.

redundant_psu.description: Whether the device supports or ships with redundant PSU.

notes.description: Freeform notes about power — wiring configuration, breaker sizing, phasing, sequencing requirements.

Port.description: A single physical port on the device. Use signal_modes for connectors that carry multiple signal types (e.g. USB-C, SFP).

id.description: Unique identifier for this port within the device profile.

label.description: Human-readable label as it appears on the device panel.

signal_type.description: Primary signal type carried on this port. For multi-mode ports, this is the default or most common mode — list all modes in signal_modes.

signal_modes.description: All signal modes this port can carry. Use for multi-mode connectors (USB-C carrying USB + DP alt mode + power; SFP carrying copper or fibre). Each mode specifies when it applies.

direction.description: Signal flow direction relative to this device.

count.description: Number of identical ports sharing this definition. If omitted, assumed to be 1.

panel_side.description: Which face of the device this port is located on.

panel_position.description: Left-to-right or top-to-bottom index of this port on its panel face, starting at 1.

management_port.description: For network ports: whether this is a dedicated out-of-band management port (distinct from data/media network ports).

universe.description: For DMX, Art-Net, or sACN ports: the universe number assigned to this port.

channel_count.description: For audio ports: number of audio channels carried on this port.

channel_count_in.description: For asymmetric bidirectional audio ports (e.g. Dante): number of receive channels. Use alongside channel_count_out.

channel_count_out.description: For asymmetric bidirectional audio ports (e.g. Dante): number of transmit channels.

sample_rate_hz.description: For digital audio ports: supported sample rate(s) in Hz. Array if multiple rates are supported.

bit_depth.description: For digital audio or video ports: supported bit depth(s). Array if multiple are supported.

gain_range_db.description: For analogue audio inputs: available gain range as [min_dB, max_dB]. Negative values indicate attenuation.

nominal_level_dbu.description: For analogue audio ports: nominal operating level in dBu.

max_level_dbu.description: For analogue audio ports: maximum level before clipping in dBu.

noise_floor_dbu.description: For analogue audio inputs: equivalent input noise (EIN) or residual output noise floor in dBu. Lower is better.

dynamic_range_db.description: For audio ports: dynamic range in dB.

thd_percent.description: For analogue audio ports: Total Harmonic Distortion percentage at rated output.

frequency_response_hz.description: For audio ports: usable frequency response as [min_hz, max_hz].

phantom_power.description: For XLR microphone inputs: whether +48V DC phantom power is available on this port.

phantom_power_v.description: Phantom power voltage if non-standard (default is 48V).

latency_ms.description: Signal processing latency through this port in milliseconds. For audio ports this is the codec/conversion latency; for video the processing delay.

impedance_ohm.description: Port impedance in ohms. Critical for SDI (75Ω), AES3 (110Ω), RS-485 (120Ω termination).

max_resolution.description: For video ports: maximum supported resolution and frame rate.

pixel_clock_mhz.description: For video input ports: maximum supported pixel clock in MHz.

hdcp.description: For video ports: whether HDCP copy protection is supported.

poe_class.description: For PoE ports: IEEE 802.3 power class. Class 4 = 30W (PoE+), Class 8 = 90W (PoE++).

poe_role.description: For PoE-capable ports: PSE (Power Sourcing Equipment — provides power) or PD (Powered Device — consumes power).

voltage_v.description: For DC power ports: voltage in volts.

current_a.description: For DC power ports: maximum current in amperes.

termination.description: For RS-485 / DMX ports: whether this device has a built-in 120Ω termination resistor that can be switched in.

loopthrough.description: Whether this port supports loop-through output.

passive_loop.description: True if loopthrough is entirely passive. False if actively regenerated/reclocked.

notes.description: Freeform notes specific to this port — known quirks, configuration requirements, or compatibility caveats.

output_power_w.description: Output power ratings at different load impedances. For amplifier speaker outputs.

watts.description: Maximum continuous output power in watts

bridged.description: True if this rating is for bridged mono operation

requires_variant.description: If set, this port only exists when the device model_variant matches one of these values.

requires_option.description: If set, this port requires a named optional module, card, or licence to be present.

slot_id.description: For ports on installed cards, references the CardSlot.id this port belongs to.

SignalMode.description: A single signal mode for a multi-mode port. Describes one of the signal types the port can carry and when it applies.

condition.description: Human-readable description of when this mode is active or available.

mutually_exclusive.description: Whether this mode is mutually exclusive with other modes on the same port (cannot be active simultaneously).

notes.description: Additional notes about this signal mode.

OperationalMode.description: A named configuration in which a specific set of ports is active. Use for devices where port groups are mutually exclusive (e.g. '4x HD-SDI OR 2x 3G-SDI on the same physical connectors').

description.description: Further explanation of this operational mode.

active_port_ids.description: IDs of ports that are active in this operational mode. Must reference port ids defined in the ports array.

CapabilityBlock.description: A typed capability block providing device-class-specific technical depth. The 'type' field discriminates which capability sub-schema applies.

DisplayCapability.description: Capability block for projection and display devices (projectors, LED walls, monitors). Required type: 'display'.

native_resolution.description: Native panel or DMD resolution of the display, independent of input signal resolution.

brightness_iso_lm.description: Peak brightness in ISO lumens (measured to ISO 21118).

brightness_led_lm.description: Peak brightness in LED lumens (also marketed as 'light source lumens' or 'LED brightness'). NOT comparable to ANSI or ISO lumens and MUST NOT be recorded in those fields: LED lumens weight the measurement for the eye's response to colour and typically read two to three times higher than the ANSI figure for the same projector. Record the number exactly as the manufacturer states it, in the field matching the unit they used, and never convert between units.

light_source_life_hours.description: Rated light source life in hours, typically to 50% brightness.

light_source_life_condition.description: Condition at which light source life is rated (e.g. 'to 50% brightness', 'L70').

throw_ratio_min.description: Minimum throw ratio (shortest throw lens). Lower = wider angle / shorter distance.

lens_shift_v_percent.description: Vertical lens shift range as a percentage of image height (±).

lens_shift_h_percent.description: Horizontal lens shift range as a percentage of image width (±).

keystone_v_degrees.description: Vertical keystone correction range in degrees (±).

keystone_h_degrees.description: Horizontal keystone correction range in degrees (±).

built_in_warp.description: Whether the device has built-in geometric warp processing (no external warper needed).

built_in_blend.description: Whether the device has built-in edge blending.

h_sync_range_khz.description: Horizontal sync frequency range as [min_kHz, max_kHz].

v_sync_range_hz.description: Vertical sync / frame rate range as [min_Hz, max_Hz].

ComputeCapability.description: Capability block for compute-bearing devices (media servers, show controllers, embedded computers, LED processors). Required type: 'compute'.

cpu_frequency_ghz.description: Base or maximum CPU clock frequency in GHz.

storage_media_tb.description: Media / project storage in terabytes. Separate from OS storage.

os.description: Operating system (version and edition if relevant).

rtc.description: Whether the device has a hardware real-time clock (RTC).

NetworkSwitchCapability.description: Capability block for managed and unmanaged network switches. Required type: 'network-switch'.

switching_fabric_gbps.description: Total non-blocking switching fabric capacity in Gbps.

forwarding_mpps.description: Maximum forwarding rate in millions of packets per second (Mpps) at 64-byte frames.

mac_table_size.description: MAC address table size in entries.

igmp_group_limit.description: Maximum number of IGMP multicast groups supported simultaneously.

packet_buffer_mb.description: Total packet buffer memory in megabytes.

latency_us.description: Typical forwarding latency in microseconds (64-byte frames, store-and-forward).

managed.description: Whether the switch is managed (configurable via CLI/GUI/SNMP).

layer.description: Highest OSI layer at which the switch operates (L2, L3, or L4).

av_profiles.description: Pre-configured AV-over-IP profiles supported (e.g. Dante, AES67, NDI, AVB, Q-SYS, SVSI).

avb_support.description: Whether the switch supports Audio Video Bridging (IEEE 802.1BA).

ptp_support.description: Whether the switch supports IEEE 1588 Precision Time Protocol.

jumbo_frame_kb.description: Maximum supported jumbo frame size in kilobytes.

lag_count.description: Maximum number of Link Aggregation Groups (LAGs).

LedProcessorCapability.description: Capability block for LED video processors and controllers (Brompton, Novastar, Colorlight, etc.). Required type: 'led-processor'.

max_output_pixels_total.description: Total maximum pixel output capacity across all outputs combined.

pixels_per_1g_output.description: Nominal pixel capacity per 1G Ethernet output port at reference conditions (typically 8bpc, 60Hz).

pixels_per_output_conditions.description: Reference conditions for the pixels_per_1g_output figure.

supported_bit_depths.description: Supported output bit depths in bits per channel.

supported_frame_rates_hz.description: Supported output frame rates in Hz.

hdr_support.description: Whether the processor supports HDR output to LED fixtures.

per_panel_calibration.description: Whether the processor supports per-LED-panel calibration (e.g. Brompton DynaCal, Novastar NCTS).

genlock_support.description: Whether the processor supports analogue genlock/sync reference input.

redundancy_support.description: Whether the processor supports hot-standby redundancy configuration.

AudioIOCapability.description: Capability block for audio interfaces, stageboxes, consoles, and processors. Captures device-level audio performance beyond individual port specs. Required type: 'audio-io'.

supported_sample_rates_hz.description: All supported internal sample rates in Hz.

ein_dbu.description: Equivalent Input Noise in dBu at maximum gain. Lower is better.

residual_noise_dbu.description: Residual output noise in dBu with master off.

thd_percent.description: Total Harmonic Distortion percentage at rated output level.

crosstalk_db.description: Channel crosstalk in dB at 1kHz (negative value). Lower is better (more negative).

signal_delay_ms.description: Total signal delay input-to-output in milliseconds.

dante_channel_count_in.description: For Dante-equipped devices: total receivable Dante audio channels.

dante_channel_count_out.description: For Dante-equipped devices: total transmittable Dante audio channels.

gain_compensation.description: Whether the device supports automatic digital gain compensation when analogue gain is adjusted remotely (e.g. Yamaha Gain Compensation).

SignalType.description: Hierarchical signal type namespace. Use the most specific subtype available. Parsers encountering unknown values MUST treat them as opaque strings and must not error.
SignalType.$comment: Format: domain/protocol[/subtype]. Unknown future subtypes are valid — the enum is a known-good reference set, not an exhaustive list.

ConnectorType.description: Physical connector type. Parsers encountering unknown values MUST treat them as opaque strings and must not error. Use 'unspecified' ONLY when the source documents the port but not its connector — never as a default for a connector you have not looked up.

VideoResolution.description: Video resolution and frame rate specification.

fps.description: Frame rate(s) in Hz. Array if multiple are supported.

colour_space.description: Colour subsampling format at maximum resolution.

hdr.description: Supported HDR formats at this resolution.

Protocol.description: An application-layer protocol supported by this device.

universe_count.description: For DMX-over-IP protocols: number of universes supported.

channel_count.description: For audio protocols: total routable channel count.

notes.description: Important notes about this protocol implementation — known limitations, required configuration, AES67 compatibility mode.

ControlCapabilities.description: Control and integration capabilities of this device.

web_ui.description: Whether the device has a built-in HTTP web interface for configuration.

rest_api.description: Whether the device exposes a REST API.

snmp.description: Whether the device supports SNMP monitoring.

dante_controller.description: Whether the device is configurable via Dante Controller.

rdm_addressable.description: Whether the device can be addressed and configured via RDM.

nfc.description: Whether the device supports NFC for configuration or pairing.

companion_software.description: Named companion software applications used to configure or control this device.

platform.description: Platforms the companion software runs on.

url.description: Download or product page URL for the companion software.

custom_commands.description: RS-232, RS-485, or TCP/IP command strings for common control operations.

command.description: The raw command string, hex-encoded if binary.

ProfileMeta.description: Metadata about this profile document — who created it, when, and its verification status.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 date this profile was first created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 date this profile was last updated.

created_by.description: GitHub username, organisation, or Verified Manufacturer identifier of the profile author.

verified.description: Whether this profile has been verified against physical hardware or official documentation.

license.description: License under which this profile is contributed.

cla_signed.description: Whether the contributor signed the Conduit Contributor Licence Agreement at time of submission.

verification_method.description: How this profile was produced and verified.

confidence.description: Assessor confidence in profile accuracy. high = cross-checked against primary source; medium = single source, plausible; low = inferred or partially sourced.

last_verified_against_version.description: Firmware or hardware revision this profile was last verified against (e.g. "FW 4.2.1", "Rev B PCB").

CardSlot.description: A physical card slot in a modular frame. May be empty or populated with a Card.

accepts_card_ids.description: List of card model identifiers that are compatible with this slot.

installed_card.description: Card currently installed in this slot. Set to null or omit if slot is empty.

required.description: If true, slot must be populated for the device to function.

redundant_pair.description: Slot ID of the redundant partner for this slot (e.g. controller A mirrors B).

InstalledCard.description: A module card installed in a slot. May carry its own ports (which appear as if on the parent device).

ports.description: Ports exposed by this card. Panel position should be relative to the card, or use slot_position on the port.

sources.description: Source documents specific to this card module.

RelatedDevice.description: Reference to a device that is functionally related (panel for a frame, PSU, antenna, etc.).

relationship.description: Nature of the relationship to the parent device.

required_for_operation.description: True if the parent device cannot operate without this unit.

conduit_profile_url.description: URL to a CONDUIT profile document for this related device.

matrix_size_max.description: Maximum non-blocking matrix dimensions this node can form part of.

ports_per_frame.description: Maximum number of intercom ports this frame can carry.

hot_swap.description: Whether cards can be swapped without powering down.

fiber_ring.description: Whether this node participates in a fibre ring network.

max_node_distance_m.description: Maximum distance between nodes in metres.

supported_protocols.description: Intercom/audio protocols this matrix supports (e.g. AES67, MADI, Dante, AVB, VoIP, 4-wire).

DataSource.description: A single source document used to derive or verify information in this profile.

url.description: Direct URL to the source document or page.

title.description: Document title as it appears on the source (e.g. "X4 4-Channel High-Performance Amplifier Platform").

version.description: Document version, revision, or edition (e.g. "V1.6.0", "Rev C", "v2.0").

date.description: Publication or last-updated date of the source document.

retrieved_date.description: Date this URL was last accessed and verified to be live.

page_ref.description: Page number, section, or anchor within the document where key data was found (e.g. "p.4", "§3.2 Rear Panel", "#specifications").

fields_sourced.description: List of profile field paths this source specifically covers (e.g. ["power.max_wattage", "ports[].signal_type"]). Omit to imply general coverage.

notes.description: Freeform note about this source — e.g. limitations, known discrepancies, or why a third-party source was used.
